#### `rx_output_emphasis_type`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `peak_to_peak_constant` | Peak-to-peak constant or not implemented |
| 0x01 | `steady_state_constant` | Steady-state constant |
| 0x02 | `averaged_constant` | Average of peak-to-peak and steady-state stays constant |
| 0x03 | `reserved` | Reserved |

#### `rx_output_amplitude_supported`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `amplitude_0000` | Rx output amplitude code 0000 supported |
| 0x01 | `amplitude_0001` | Rx output amplitude code 0001 supported |
| 0x02 | `amplitude_0010` | Rx output amplitude code 0010 supported |
| 0x03 | `amplitude_0011` | Rx output amplitude code 0011 supported |
